newsitem.title: INDIA: Illinois Tool raises stake in Indian firm.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Tool raises stake in Indian firm.

text.p: U.S.-based Illinois Tool Works Inc. has acquired a majority equity stake in its India affiliate company, the local firm said in a statement on Thursday.

ITW Signode India Ltd said its directors have allotted 7.03 million shares at a price of 585.6 million rupees to the U.S. firm, taking the American company's total holdings to 51 percent from 29.25 percent.

The preferential allotment was priced at 83.25 rupees per share of 10-rupees face value, the statement said, adding this was done in accordance with Securities and Exchange Board of India rules and approved by the central bank.
The ITW Signode share was up 4.5 rupees at 103 on the Bombay Stock Exchange in early afternoon trade on Friday.
The Indian firm is engaged in the manufacture of packaging machinery, equipment systems, engineered polymers, mechanical and electronic components, industrial lubricants and speciality chemicals.
